title: Propagation of the diagonal formula to all etale objects
statement:
theorem equivariantModulePresheaf_pointwise_of_diagonal
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (ℓ : ℕ) {P : Type u} [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V)
    (N N' : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P)
    (η : c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N ⟶ c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N')
    (f : N.V →ₗ[ZMod ℓ] N'.V)
    (hf : letI := c.etale
      ∀ (s : c.equivariantSections ℓ N (Etale.mk c.π)) (x : c.P),
        (η.app (op (Etale.mk c.π)) s).val
            ((pullback.lift (f := c.π) (g := c.π) (𝟙 c.P) (𝟙 c.P) rfl) x) =
          f (s.val ((pullback.lift (f := c.π) (g := c.π) (𝟙 c.P) (𝟙 c.P) rfl) x))) :
    ∀ (W : V.Etale) (s : c.equivariantSections ℓ N W) (x : c.sectionSpace W),
      (η.app (op W) s).val x = f (s.val x)

proof.text: Fix W, s and x. Use diagonalEvaluation_surjective at b0(x), where b0 is the second pullback projection, to choose a section q with diagonal value s(x). This witness is used only in a proof, not as definition data. Pull the locally constant diagonal values of q back along b0. Intersect its open fiber at s(x) with the open fiber of s at s(x), giving an open O containing x.

Regard O as an etale object B over c.P and push it forward to the etale object U over V. Its maps a to W and b to the torsor define a graph k into U times_V c.P. Pullback hom_ext shows k followed by sectionRestriction(a) is O.ι and k followed by sectionRestriction(b) is b followed by the diagonal. The two restricted sections have equal graph values by the definition of O. Apply injectivity of diagonalEvaluation_bijective on B to identify these restrictions.

Apply naturality of eta along a and b to this equality and evaluate on the graph at x. The resulting equality identifies eta_W(s)(x) with eta_torsor(q) at the diagonal of b0(x). Apply hf, then the defining equality for q, obtaining f(s(x)).
